visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: sorted with a key Instead of a Hand-Written Sort
visualizerParams.problemDescription: A bubble sort with a compound comparison orders the students by marks (high first) and then by name. Use sorted with a key. The output must stay the same.

solution.code:
students = [("Ravi", 72), ("Meena", 91), ("Kiran", 72), ("Asha", 91)]
items = sorted(students, key=lambda s: (-s[1], s[0]))
print(items)
solution.explanation: The key function states the ordering rule in one line. sorted is faster than a bubble sort and cannot get the compound comparison wrong.
